note: Ersatz fuer abgelehnte Bilder aus den Pruefboegen 11/12/13 (16.10.)

images.f13_storm_far_v2: Seen from a far-away safe rocky hill, a huge dark heavy cloud spreading a deep shadow over a small distant desert town of low flat-roofed mud-brick houses with palm trees, the town is empty, ominous but not scary. Only low flat-roofed houses, nothing tall.
images.f11_family_reunion_hall_v2: A grand ancient hall with sand-colored stone walls, a raised stone platform with a simple wooden throne seat and soft cushions, carpets on the floor, warm oil lamps on stands and flickering clay lamps, celebratory warm light, the hall is empty. No electric lights, no light bulbs. No figures or carvings on the walls, no writing.
images.f11_shirt_light_v2: A simple ancient linen tunic without collar and without buttons, softly folded on a cushion, glowing with a soft warm magical light, gentle golden sparkles around it, dark calm background.
images.f11_seven_cows_v2: A dreamlike landscape split in two: on the left a lush green riverside meadow with soft grass, on the right dry cracked brown ground, soft pastel dream colors and a gentle glow, calm and mysterious.
images.f12_wilted_garden_v2: A small garden next to a modest stone house with a flat roof, the plants are dry, brown and wilted, bare branches, under a grey cloudy sky, gentle sadness, not scary.
images.f13_blocked_road_v2: A dusty sandy desert path at dusk blocked by a pile of large rough boulders, long shadows, uneasy but not scary. No asphalt, no paved road.
images.f12_empty_sickbed_v2: A humble ancient stone room with a simple sleeping mat and a woolen blanket on the floor, a clay cup of water and a small clay oil lamp beside it, a small square window with grey daylight, quiet and calm, the mat is empty.
images.f14_desert_road_long_v2: A long lonely sandy desert trail winding between rocky hills under a hot sun, the trail is just soft sand, a feeling of a long journey. No asphalt, no paved road, no road markings.
images.f14_night_desert_departure_v2: A quiet desert at night under a soft starry sky, gentle sand dunes leading toward a distant shimmering sea on the horizon, a faint path in the sand, peaceful and hopeful. Natural stars only, no lines between stars.
images.f08_two_hills_v3: Two small rocky brown hills facing each other across a wide dry sandy valley floor, low bare mountains behind, a faint worn path in the sand running between the two hills, hot clear sky, empty and quiet.
images.f08_two_hills_v4: A wide sandy valley between two separate low rugged hills made of jagged grey-brown rocks and boulders, one rocky hill on the left and one rocky hill on the right, uneven irregular rocky shapes, not round and not smooth, a faint path in the sand between them, low mountains far behind, hot clear sky, empty and quiet.
